Title: Public preview: Azure API Management support for OpenAPI Specification v3

Body.Content:
We've introduced preview support of OpenAPI Specification v3 in Azure API Management. OpenAPI Specification v3 is the latest version of the broadly used open-source standard of describing APIs.

Azure API Management now supports:

  • Import of OpenAPI Specification v3 files in the JSON and YAML formats in the Azure portal and through the REST API. Certain import restrictions apply.
  • Export of OpenAPI Specification v3 files in the JSON and YAML formats in the Azure portal and the developer portal, as well as through the REST API (YAML only).

You can learn more about the announcement in our blog post.
